answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 49605 Country: India Title: salaam Question: Could SALAM be upon other personality apart from nabi (s.a.w.)? Answer ID: 49605 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 197/167/B=02/1435) It is alright to send blessings (durood and salam) only to the Messenger (صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم) and other prophets (علیہھم السلام). It may not be sent directly to anyone else except them, but it can be sent indirectly to his holy wives, sahaba, his descendants and followers along with the Prophet (صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
